forward_projection: historical week-specific Sleeper projection only if B41A proves the source can be reconstructed without known outcome leakage
historical week-specific FantasyPros projection only if B41A proves the source can be reconstructed without known outcome leakage

DB: tackles, assists, passes defended and interceptions where available
DL: tackles, sacks, TFL, QB hits and pressures where available
LB: tackles, assists, TFL, sacks and QB hits where available
QB: designed+rushing attempts per active game where available

feature_normalization.rule: Continuous signals are converted to within-position, origin-week percentiles before model fitting unless a later preregistered phase demonstrates a scientific reason not to do so.

candidate_models.name: nonnegative_linear_rank_model
candidate_models.purpose: learn nonnegative signal weights from historical data; weights are estimated, not hand assigned

candidate_models.name: monotonic_nonlinear_challenger
candidate_models.purpose: allow stable nonlinearities while constraining higher usage/production/projection signals from perversely lowering predicted role

model_development_plan.complexity_rule: Use a one-standard-error style rule: if a simpler candidate is statistically indistinguishable from the best development candidate, select the simpler candidate.
model_development_plan.selection_metric_primary: mean absolute error of predicted versus realized future within-position target percentile

post_validation_production_plan.future_retraining: Requires a separately versioned research workflow and new preregistration.
post_validation_production_plan.weekly_job_behavior: Apply frozen model weights, transformations, and tier thresholds to fresh completed-week data. Weekly runs may update player roles but may not refit the model.
post_validation_production_plan.weekly_schedule: Tuesday after the previous NFL week is complete

problem_definition.production_use_constraint: No player role, role multiplier, ranking total, or player FV may change until the historical model has been developed, frozen, and passed untouched holdout validation.
problem_definition.purpose: Replace hand-curated player role labels with an owner-blind, empirically derived forward-looking role state that summarizes near-term NFL opportunity and fantasy contribution.
role_is_not: roster slot on a fantasy team

projection_provenance_rule.requirement: A historical projection source may enter development only if the workflow can establish it is genuinely week-specific and does not contain realized outcomes. If capture-time/as-of provenance is not sufficiently defensible, projection features remain outside the historical fitted model and may be evaluated only prospectively.

target_architecture.active_game_definition: game in which the player is active and has documented offensive, defensive, or special-teams participation; injury absences are not automatically treated as zero-role games
target_architecture.primary_target: next-4-active-game league-scored fantasy points per game, converted to an origin-week within-position percentile
target_architecture.reason_for_horizon: Four active games is preregistered as a compromise between weekly noise and season-long staleness. Two- and six-game horizons are sensitivity analyses only and cannot replace the primary result.
target_architecture.secondary_target: next-4-active-game mean snap-share percentile within position, for positions where offensive/defensive snap share is meaningful

tier_derivation_plan.method: After the winning continuous role score is frozen from development data, derive exactly seven ordered contiguous score intervals using development out-of-fold predictions only. Boundaries will be chosen algorithmically to maximize separation in the primary future target subject to minimum-cell-size and monotonicity constraints.

untouched_holdout_validation.failure_consequence: No production deployment. A failed holdout closes this version or requires a new preregistered model version with a new untouched test.
primary_tests: paired season/week-cluster bootstrap comparison of absolute prediction error versus the best single-signal baseline
bootstrap confidence interval for pooled Spearman association between frozen role score and future target
ordered role tiers must show non-decreasing future production on holdout data
for snap-relevant positions, ordered role tiers must show non-decreasing future snap share on holdout data
